PV Sindhu criticizes Asian Games badminton schedule after early exit

Indian badminton player PV Sindhu has criticized the scheduling of matches at the Asian Games following her exit from the competition. Sindhu stated that playing three matches in an 18-hour period was "gruelling" and took a toll on her performance, contributing to her "painful exit." She highlighted that the demanding schedule impacted her ability to compete effectively.
